findings.title: Unauthenticated Dummy Token Bypass in MarketDataProvider
findings.evidence: In market_bridge.py line 139, if self.ledger is None, token verification was skipped entirely after checking only if not test_token or not test_token.strip(). Any arbitrary string like test_token='dummy_bypass' returned the full 149 bars of the sealed TEST partition.
findings.actual_impact: An agent or researcher could bypass cryptographic authorization by simply omitting the ledger argument or instantiating a fresh provider, gaining unauthorized access to untouched out-of-sample test data.
findings.recommended_remediation: Enforce that partition == 'TEST' strictly requires self.ledger is not None, test_token is non-empty, and prereg_id is present, verifying and consuming the token against the ledger.
findings.fix_details: Added guard in MarketDataProvider.get_partition_data: if self.ledger is None: raise SealedPartitionAccessViolation. Also required non-empty prereg_id and routed verification through verify_and_consume_test_token.
findings.remaining_limitations: Direct Python file opening of cached_klines_*.json can still read the raw data on the local filesystem outside the MarketDataProvider class.

findings.title: Transaction Rollback Failure in ResearchLedger Leaves Orphan Corrupt Records
findings.evidence: record_experiment_result performed multi-table inserts into experiments, experiment_metrics, and audit_results without a transaction context manager or rollback handler. If step 3 failed (e.g. KeyError), partially inserted experiments and experiment_metrics rows remained pending and were committed by subsequent calls.
findings.reproduction_method: Call record_experiment_result with invalid audit_data raising KeyError, then call record_trial. The failed experiment was permanently committed.
findings.actual_impact: Database corruption and orphaned experiment records with incomplete audit data. Because database triggers prohibit DELETE and UPDATE, these partial records could never be removed.
findings.recommended_remediation: Wrap the multi-table insert block in 'try: with self.conn: ... except Exception: self.conn.rollback(); raise'.
findings.fix_details: Wrapped all operations in record_experiment_result with 'try: with self.conn: ... except Exception: self.conn.rollback(); raise'.
findings.remaining_limitations: None. SQLite ACID transaction management ensures atomic all-or-nothing commits.

findings.title: Authorization Token Replay via max_uses and expires_at Trigger Tampering
findings.evidence: The prevent_auth_tampering trigger only checked token_hash, prereg_id, and uses_count > OLD.max_uses. It did not prohibit UPDATE test_evaluation_authorizations SET max_uses = 100 or extending expires_at or clearing is_revoked.
findings.reproduction_method: cur.execute('UPDATE test_evaluation_authorizations SET max_uses = 100;'). The trigger did not abort, permitting token replay.
findings.actual_impact: Any SQL caller could convert a single-use token into a multi-use token, un-revoke a revoked token, or extend an expired token indefinitely.
findings.recommended_remediation: Strengthen trigger to prohibit changes to auth_id, token_hash, prereg_id, authorized_by, created_at, expires_at, max_uses, and un-revoking (OLD.is_revoked = 1 AND NEW.is_revoked = 0), and prevent decrementing uses_count.
findings.fix_details: Updated prevent_auth_tampering trigger in schema.py to strictly enforce immutability of auth_id, token_hash, prereg_id, authorized_by, created_at, expires_at, max_uses, prevent decrementing uses_count, and prevent clearing is_revoked.
findings.remaining_limitations: Direct SQL 'DROP TRIGGER' commands by a database administrator or malicious agent with DDL permissions can still drop triggers if raw SQL execution is permitted.

findings.title: Partition Boundary Tampering via Class-Level PARTITIONS Mutation
findings.evidence: MarketDataProvider.PARTITIONS was a mutable class dictionary. Mutating MarketDataProvider.PARTITIONS['TRAIN']['end_bar'] = 729 expanded the TRAIN partition to 699 bars, returning VALIDATION and TEST bars without authentication across all instances.
findings.reproduction_method: p = MarketDataProvider(); p.PARTITIONS['TRAIN']['end_bar'] = 729; p.get_partition_data('TRAIN') returned 699 bars.
findings.actual_impact: In-memory state manipulation allowed complete bypass of partition walls without generating any token or audit log.
findings.recommended_remediation: Store partition bounds in an immutable internal dictionary (_IMMUTABLE_BOUNDS) and ensure get_partition_data strictly reads from the immutable bounds.
findings.fix_details: Introduced _IMMUTABLE_BOUNDS in MarketDataProvider and ensured get_partition_data reads strictly from _IMMUTABLE_BOUNDS. Exposed PARTITIONS as a decoupled copy for inspection.
findings.remaining_limitations: Python in-process reflection / monkey patching can alter private attributes if untrusted arbitrary code execution is permitted within the same process.

findings.title: In-Memory Simulation Loophole Permitting Unaccounted Parameter Search
findings.evidence: execute_strategy_simulation is a standalone function decoupled from ResearchLedger. An agent or researcher could run 10,000 parameter trials in memory on TRAIN or VALIDATION and only log a single trial to trial_ledger.
findings.reproduction_method: Loop execute_strategy_simulation for 100 parameter sets without calling ledger.record_trial(). The ledger records M_total = 0.
findings.actual_impact: Multiple testing accounting (M_total) relies on voluntary or wrapper-based reporting. Undocumented in-memory parameter searches can lead to uncorrected p-hacking and inflated DSR.
findings.fix_details: Implemented ResearchExecutionEngine in trader/agent/core/execution.py as the mandatory controlled execution pathway. Enforced pre-execution trial registration (trial_id created before simulation runs), preregistration grid validation, canonical parameter serialization, failed trial persistence, and interrupted trial reconciliation. Isolated execute_strategy_simulation() with explicit warning that it is an internal numerical kernel and not an authorized agent execution pathway.
findings.remaining_limitations: Python-level encapsulation cannot physically prevent a determined local developer from calling internal functions directly via Python scripts; true physical sandboxing requires OS-level process isolation.

findings.title: Circular Benchmark Parity Verification in Prototype Unit Tests
findings.evidence: The prototype unit test extracted results['cagr_pct'] and results['annualized_vol_pct'], called benchmark_engine.calc_sharpe_ratio, and asserted equality with results['sharpe_ratio']. But results['sharpe_ratio'] was generated by that exact same function call in market_bridge.py. The test also used a dummy constant array [0.0002]*400 for bootstrap testing.
findings.actual_impact: False confidence in independent benchmark parity; failure to detect formula or assumption discrepancies.
findings.recommended_remediation: Compute Sharpe ratio, CAGR, and annualized volatility independently from the raw daily return series using first-principles formulas in the test and verify mathematical parity.
findings.fix_details: Implemented independent first-principles CAGR and annual volatility calculations directly from daily returns in tests/test_agent_adversarial_audit.py, verifying parity with benchmark_engine.
findings.remaining_limitations: Benchmark engine calc_cagr uses 365.25 annualization (accounting for leap years), which must be consistently applied.

findings.title: Timezone-Naive Datetime Comparison Crash in Token Verification
findings.evidence: Comparing aware now_dt (UTC) with a naive datetime string in expires_at raises TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes.
findings.reproduction_method: Insert authorization with naive datetime string '2020-01-01 00:00:00' and call verify_and_consume_test_token.
findings.actual_impact: Runtime crash on non-ISO8601 aware timestamps inserted via external SQL scripts.
findings.recommended_remediation: Normalize parsed datetime to UTC if tzinfo is None prior to comparison.
findings.fix_details: Added 'if expires_dt.tzinfo is None: expires_dt = expires_dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)' in verify_and_consume_test_token.

findings.title: Protection is Provider-Level Access Control, Not Physical Data Isolation
findings.evidence: The raw candle cache JSON files are stored unencrypted on disk. Existing modules (benchmark_engine.py, audit_v5_1.py, etc.) load all 729 bars directly. MarketDataProvider.raw_caches exposes all bars as a public dictionary.
findings.actual_impact: Protection category is Category A (Provider-level access control) within MarketDataProvider.get_partition_data(). It is NOT Category B (Application-wide) or Category C (Actual physical or cryptographic data isolation).
findings.recommended_remediation: Clearly document the protection category as Provider-Level Access Control. In future phases, consider encrypting test data at rest or isolating it in an authenticated remote vault service.
findings.fix_details: Explicitly documented in audit report, api reference, and adversarial test suite.
findings.remaining_limitations: Offline research codebase shares filesystem with historical test files.
